data.description: You must succeed on a melee touch attack. Your touch deals 1d6 points of damage per two caster levels [maximum 10d6]. You gain temporary hit points equal to the damage you deal. You can't gain more than the subject's current hit points + the subject's Constitution score [which is enough to kill the subject]. The temporary hit points disappear 1 hour later.
